source_note: n个连续的阶乘之积有多少个因子
english_source_note: How Many Divisors in a Product of n Consecutive Factorials
callout_id: n个连续的阶乘之积有多少个因子#1
statement_en: Let $d(n)$ denote the number of positive divisors of the integer $n$, and define $$D(n):=d(1!\cdot 2!\cdots n!).$$ Find the limit $$\lim_{n\to \infty}D(n)^{1/n}.$$
prerequisites: factorization of factorials via prime valuations
callout_body: 函数$d(n)$表示整数$n$的因子的个数，定义$$D(n):=d(1!\cdot 2!\cdots n!)$$求极限$$\lim_{n\to \infty}D(n)^{1/n}$$
